subject: Preflight: Vendor activation — COI, subcontractor list, and next steps
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@clearsky.io>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, procurement@redwood.com
Cc: agreements@clearsky.io
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: New supplier onboarding — docs attached

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. As discussed, attaching our initial items for Redwood's vendor setup. Can you confirm the exact COI language you require and whether a blanket endorsement to include subcontractors is necessary? We typically provide a standard COI and a claims history PDF — attaching both. Also including our W-9 and a spreadsheet of subcontractors we use on network deployments.

What we need from your side to get a PO created? Is there any procurement intake form we should populate besides the W-9 and COI? Were aiming to be live for the pilot by Dec 1.

Attachments: clearsky-claims-history.pdf (pdf), clearsky-w9.pdf (pdf), clearsky-subcontractors.csv (csv)

Best,
Sam Patel
Head of Operations
ClearSky Technologies
sam.patel@clearsky.io
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@clearsky.io>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-18T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding — docs attached

Sam — thanks for sending these over and for the target date. Quick checklist and asks so our procurement and legal can queue the PO: 

1) COI: Please resend a Certificate of Insurance with the following endorsements included (or an insurer-issued endorsement page):
   - Redwood Inference, Inc. listed as "Additional Insured" on Commercial General Liability (CG 20 26 or equivalent)
   - Waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood Inference (if available)
   - Per-occurrence limits: at least $1,000,000; Aggregate: $2,000,000 (if your policy splits differently, provide notes)

2) Claims history: thank you for the PDF — procurement will need a one-page summary table of any claims in the last 5 years (dates, brief description, amount paid/reserved). The attached clearsky-claims-history.pdf is a good start but the summary helps for underwriting review.

3) Subcontractor list: the CSV is helpful. Please indicate which subcontractors will have access to customer environments/data (if any). For any that will, we need similar insurance evidence or a signed subcontractor addendum.

4) W-9: received.

5) PO path: Once we have revised COI + claims summary + confirmation on subcontractor access, procurement (cc'd) can issue a conditional PO to support pilot onboarding. Final PO will issue after endorsements are confirmed. If finance/legal need a special vendor form, we'll surface it — see related Jira link below.

Im attaching our COI template (redwood-coi-template.pdf) and a vendor-onboarding-checklist.xlsx to make the fields explicit. If you can return the COI endorsement page by end of week, we can meet the Dec 1 pilot target.

Thanks — Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Strategic Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com

Thanks Sergio/Kimberly — attaching a revised COI export and a short claims-summary (two pages). A couple of clarifying items:

- The insurer provided an endorsement that adds Redwood as additional insured on the CG policy but they declined a blanket waiver of subrogation; they can provide a specifically worded endorsement naming Redwood and the policy effective date (no retroactive language).
- The subcontractor CSV flags two partners that will touch customer infra; we have initiated an insurance pull for those two and expect confirmation by Tuesday.

Attachments: clearsky-coi-rev.pdf (pdf), clearsky-claims-summary.pdf (pdf)

Let us know if the COI revision satisfies the requirement or if you need the exact form language from the insurer. We can also provide broker contact if underwriting wants to speak directly.

Sam

All — I reviewed the revised COI and claims summary. Two action items before procurement issues the conditional PO: 

1) Request insurer endorsement PDF that explicitly lists Redwood Inference, Inc. as "Additional Insured" (we need the insurers endorsement page, not just the agent cover note). The clearsky-coi-rev.pdf looks close but the endorsement page is missing — please ask broker to resend the endorsement page.

2) For the two subcontractors that will access infra, ask ClearSky to either (a) provide matching COIs for those subs or (b) sign our subcontractor addendum (I attached the addendum to the procurement Jira ticket).

Procurement: please prepare a conditional PO for pilot scope capped at $15,000 and include the following note in the PO: 
"PO issued conditionally pending receipt of insurer endorsement page confirming Additional Insured status and subcontractor insurance confirmation. Final PO to follow upon validation."

Sam — can you confirm ETA to get the endorsement page and subcontractor insurance? If we have those by EOD Tuesday (11/23), procurement can issue the conditional PO Wednesday morning.

Thanks — Mina Haddad
Vendor Risk Analyst
Redwood Inference
